thread.title: tZERO Sale Closing News Announcements And Clients Signing On Will Drive Overstock And tZERO Token Higher - Overstock.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:OSTK)

author: Opaque Investors
title: tZERO Sale Closing News Announcements And Clients Signing On Will Drive Overstock And tZERO Token Higher - Overstock.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:OSTK)
text:
The crypto market has cooled down, with some sites indicating that the market is down to $268 billion market cap (total, including all coins). There is no debate that Bitcoin has failed to meet the hopes of many (that it would go to $100,000 or higher) - it has failed. The hopers and the HOLDers are still hoping and HOLDing, while major enterprise grade projects are taking shape in the crypto community, the most prominent and significant being the tZERO token trading platform, and we will explain why here.
First let's understand why this recent news is significant :
Our partnership with BOX Digital Markets is a significant milestone that will create the first SEC-regulated exchange designed to efficiently trade crypto securities.
This seems to not have been understood yet by the market. Overstock.com's ( OSTK ) stock price is still below $40, and few articles have been written covering this important news (it's clear that tZERO needs a PR department). If you are just learning about this topic, you can see our previous articles on Seeking Alpha covering this: "tZERO ICO About To Make Overstock A Wall Street Favorite" .
Summary tZero ICO is about to disrupt markets. KODAKCoin perhaps the first large company launching a Crypto. KODAKCoin will trade exclusively on tZERO's platform. KODAKCoin itself is not important, what is important is this is the precedent for hundreds of other big corporate coins. All the points are still true, and even more. We need to mention something about why there is so little news about this issue. There is something which is the securities equivalent of a 'cooling off' period while the sale is taking place. The sale is officially not closed yet; while they have raised the full $250 million, according to most sources, the funds and accounts from outside USA have not been processed and received yet. So, during the sale period, which has lasted more than 6 months, tZERO isn't allowed to make any statements, press releases, or any other news that might create a buzz. So you can bet that once the sale closes, lots of news and announcements will be brightly forthcoming.
tZERO will have the world's first regulated crypto exchange, which is regulated the same way as the NYSE or any other exchange - it's a real 'exchange' not just by name. The crypto 'exchanges' called themselves exchanges and it's amazing the CFTC has been so quiet on this topic. But we're not here to pick on Coinbase, we're here to elaborate how powerful it will be when the tZERO exchange, which is fully regulated and compliant, is live. Let's say, for example, you are Amazon ( AMZN ) or Apple ( AAPL ) and you want to issue crypto securities. Are you likely to use a US-based Boston/NYC group, or an unregulated anonymous exchange in Vanuatu?
Yes, of course - there will be competition. But for the time being, they will be the only game in town. And the securities market is huge. Just being able to handle legacy securities - meaning the 'crypto' versions of AAPL and AMZN will attract a certain amount of business. Remember what happened in 2005/2007 during the implementation of Reg NMS?
What happened was the shifting of securities liquidity away from exchanges and into 'dark pools' and other venues, which allowed for front running and other market abuses, which finally led to new exchanges such as IEX and others.
Investors forget that tZERO purchased Speed Route, which is a popular high frequency trading service. Speed Route is currently processing a significant single-digit percentage of all securities transactions on the NASDAQ and NYSE; you can read more about it on their website .
In other words, tZERO is already a significant player in the Wall St. ecosystem. It isn't as if these are 2 dudes who just got on Shark Tank. tZERO has a trading platform, which is not only a front end but also an order matching system, order routing system, and much more ( watch the walkthrough here ). With the combination of a regulated exchange, this is the perfect combination to attract corporate institutional customers from Wall St. such as Goldman Sachs ( GS ) and others.
Perhaps this is why George Soros invested $100 million in the model. Not to make any judgments about Soros here, but you can say he has an unusual track record for success.
How will the tZERO token trade? There has been some doubt that, although all this being the case, the tZERO token may not rise so much when it trades live. Let's examine at least one thing that may bid it up. European investors liked the tZERO token perhaps more than Americans. They had a capital requirement as part of the EU regulation there, that made the minimum investment 100,000 Euros. That's not a huge amount of capital, but at the same time, it is a lot to invest for the average investor in just one investment. For example, if there is $400,000 in your portfolio, it's not wise to put 25% in tZERO. Any financial adviser would say that. 10% or less is good for 'high risk' investments. So we are talking about a rich demographic of accredited and high net-worth Europeans.
So, once the token starts trading on an exchange where there is no minimum, all the investors who couldn't meet the 100k Euro requirement will have the opportunity to buy in. Will they drive the price up? Consider this.
What made Bitcoin go from $1 to $20,000 was mostly accessibility. Institutional money has only dribbled into Bitcoin in the last 12 months, notably in the last 6 months. What mostly drove BTC/USD so high were people in 3rd world countries buying $50 worth of Bitcoin because there isn't a developed investment market in Venezuela, for example. It wasn't the funds, it wasn't even the middle class - it was the unbanked, the hackers and geeks that said why not, let's throw in $1,000 and see what happens. The point is that it was small money from around the world that drove Bitcoin higher, not institutions.
Material facts you should know about this offering: tZERO is a subsidiary of Overstock.com, a publicly traded company. tZERO token holders are getting 80% (number subject to change) of the profits from the platform. That is a very big incentive. Overstock.com is really the only corporate 'early adopter' as they started offering employee pay options for Bitcoin as early as 2014. tZERO token offering is the world's first SEC registered token offering, click here to see the full Private Placement Memorandum from SEC.GOV. This is the world's first STO (Securities Token Offering). One note about the legitimacy of ICOs. The SEC has released lots of documents which in many ways created more confusion than it cleared. Each ICO started to decide for themselves whether they are 'utility tokens' or 'securities tokens', but this may be a moot point. Think for a moment about your traditional stock broker. When you open an account, they do the KYC/AML and you fund with the broker who is also the custodian of your funds. They provide the trading platform, data, and access to their investment instruments, typically from big exchanges like the NYSE/NASDAQ, CME/CBOE and others. It is the exchange's role to only list issues which are vetted and regulated - not the broker-dealer and certainly not the customer. Furthermore, the customer opens with the custodian, not with the company issuing the securities. Imagine the confusion if Microsoft ( MSFT ) had to vet all investors of their shares if they are accredited or not. It is impractical. So for this reason, exchanges which are in the US are cautious about listing new crypto issues that may or may not be securities. It's actually amazing that these 'exchanges' haven't been contacted or subpoenaed by the CFTC which is the typical regulator of most non-securities exchanges. Or perhaps this demand for data is the first move in a larger crackdown .
In any case, the point is that the partnership with BOX Digital Markets LLC is very significant - because this will be effectively the first regulated securities crypto brokerage (exchange) in the world. Note also that many funds are prohibited from investing in crypto because it is not regulated (Calpers cannot withdraw $1 billion in cash, it's against their rules. They couldn't possibly do it even if they wanted to). So there's a lot of institutional money waiting for institutional grade products to buy and sell in crypto, on a regulated platform in a regulated exchange. It's amazing that most out there still don't get how big tZERO can be.
We are long the stock, long the token, and look forward to trading on the platform, as well as making our own regulated crypto listings!
What investors should look out for in the coming months: The sale closing has been extended a 3rd time to June 29, 2018. After the sale closing, expect to hear more news coming out from tZERO. Note that the tZERO platform is separate from the exchange partnership. It is possible the tZERO platform could be licensed to other broker-dealers or exchanges (that hasn't been hinted at, we are just elaborating the possibility - this is not an exclusive deal). Box Options Exchange LLC is a national securities exchange established in 2002 which will make this venture the world's first U.S. regulated security token exchange. This will attract a lot of institutions which cannot otherwise invest in crypto. STOs which want to launch on a regulated platform funded by Silicon Valley VC groups, funds, and Wall St. groups. The tZERO token to begin trading on an exchange, at first in Europe, and later in more places. Demand for Overstock.com as the token does well. For those who don't meet the minimums or don't want to mess with the token, OSTK is a good derivative play. As my mentor used to say, enjoy the ride!
Disclosure: I am/we are long OSTK.
